task.description: Implement EXT-05 sub-process support in backend per src/design/ext-05-sub-process-support.md. Add SUB_PROCESS node handling so parent execution starts a child instance from referenced definition and sets parent token to WAITING. Ensure child receives a copy of parent variables at activation time. On child COMPLETED, advance parent token and merge child output variables per EE-09 rules. On child ERROR, transition parent to ERROR and append CHILD_PROCESS_ERROR event including parent_instance_id and child_instance_id. On child external cancellation, transition parent to ERROR and append CHILD_PROCESS_CANCELLED with required IDs. Ensure parent cancellation does not cascade to child. Preserve child definition snapshot behavior per EE-01. Implement required persistence and runtime wiring plus validations, and add/adjust unit and integration tests covering acceptance criteria and edge cases.
acceptance_criteria: Execution reaches SUB_PROCESS and starts child instance with parent token WAITING
Child variable map is copy-on-start; parent not mutated by child until merge-on-complete
Child COMPLETED advances parent and merges child outputs per EE-09
Child ERROR and external cancellation transition parent to ERROR with required events and IDs
Parent cancellation does not cascade to child
Build, tests, and migration checks pass per BACKEND-DEV workflow

result.summary: Implemented EXT-05 sub-process support in backend: SUB_PROCESS node handling, child start from referenced definition with parent WAITING token semantics, copy-on-start child variables, merge-on-child-complete behavior, child terminal propagation to parent error events, durable linkage persistence, and non-cascading parent cancellation behavior. Added migration and unit/integration coverage; fixed runtime memory leaks in EXT-05 propagation paths.
